concept: Adapting a plan when circumstances change, without abandoning the underlying goal
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student's original plan for a goal (a project, an event, a personal target) is disrupted by a realistic unexpected change
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how to adapt the plan versus giving up on the goal entirely
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on the difference between adapting and quitting

assessment.success_marker: student proposes a genuine adaptation that keeps the underlying goal intact
